# Relaunch risks

The main risks of the website relaunch. First, vendor slippage: the agency has two other launches in November and may deliver the templates late. Second, a hidden dependency on the old search service, which nobody on the team has touched in years. Third, redirects: thousands of legacy addresses must keep working or the traffic drops.

Each risk has an owner and a trigger date. If the templates are not in by the fifteenth, we reduce the first release to the homepage and the product pages. The budget impact of each scenario is in [[Relaunch budget]].
